name: AABB Voxel Intersection
definition: Checks if two voxel sprites intersect by computing the axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) overlap and iterating through all voxel coordinates within that overlap.
summary: AABB Voxel Intersection is a brute-force method that detects collisions by iterating through every integer coordinate within a bounding box, differing from hierarchical traversal techniques.
